summary.zh: 自动化订阅扣费、开票与催收流程
summary.en: Automate recurring billing, invoicing, and dunning

description.zh: 覆盖订阅周期、试用转正式、按量计费和 proration 结算，并给出自动开票、失败重试与催收邮件（dunning）的流程设计。适合搭建 SaaS 订阅计费或在现有系统中补齐催收环节时使用。接入具体支付渠道时需要对应的 API Key 与 webhook 配置。
description.en: Covers billing cycles, trial-to-paid moves, usage-based pricing, proration, automatic invoicing, retry schedules, and dunning emails. Use it for SaaS subscription billing or failed-payment recovery. Connecting a provider needs its API keys.
